title: fact-block
description: Generated from the annexes of specs/100-specstride by contracts/tools/generate.py. The annex stands where the two differ.

manifestHash.description: Hash of the check manifest and the list of its commands by id

commands.description: Hash of the check manifest and the list of its commands by id

treeFingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the tree at the phase gate, once

units.description: Per unit of work: its id; the tasks it named, headed as the proposer's declaration; per command the exit result and, in separate fields, each condition (`tainted`, `flaky` with both observed results, `superseded` or `current`, `cached`)

unnamedTasks.description: Tasks of the phase that no unit named

notice.description: One fixed sentence: a result is evidence about the tree and not about a task

protected.description: Paths of the protected set changed since phase entry, and which were authorised from the text of the task at launch; protected paths changed since launch in phases already approved; suppression markers added and removed, per file

integrity.description: Integrity events, by kind from the closed set of §X.6, without counts
integrity.x-type-in-words: List of members of a closed set

facts.description: Further facts, each from a closed set: a check manifest that a relaunch derived differently; a cited result file that belongs to a stopped job; phase evidence that predates the tree; an intended change of a source that was accepted; a task list that changed since launch
facts.x-type-in-words: List of members of a closed set

excluded.description: Commands excluded from the inner set, each with the reason
